courseOutcomes.description: Identify factors affecting alignment of railway track for a given terrain and to explain the component parts of railway tracks, its functions, and materials of making
Carry out geometric design of railway track and to explain the construction procedure of railway tracks
Explain the basic principles, site selection characteristics and lay out of ports and harbours and the basics of docks.
Understand the concepts of various structures on harbours and navigational aids for communication.
